description: Plans a one-off or recurring meeting with people in other time zones when its time is known (e.g. "every other Tuesday at 10:00 Berlin time with Anna in Tbilisi"). Expands it into concrete dates and shows each one in every participant's local time, with working-hours checks, public holidays and daylight-saving shifts. Saves the schedule for 30 days and returns a private perfectclock.cc/s/... link that opens it in Perfect Clock.

maxOccurrences.description: How many upcoming meetings to list.

participants.description: People or places the meeting must suit, each with their own time zone.

label.description: How the participant or place is called in the conversation, e.g. "Anna" or "Tokyo office".

tz.description: IANA time zone of this participant, e.g. Asia/Tbilisi.

byDay.description: Weekdays for weekly rules; for monthly with setPos, the weekday.

setPos.description: Monthly "Nth weekday": 1-4, or -1 for the last.

start.description: First possible date in `tz`; default today.

tz.description: Time zone the meeting time is fixed in (usually the organizer's).

name: plan_meeting_schedule
title: Plan a meeting schedule
